blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Philippine shares posted modest gains on Wednesday, but the recovery remained fragile as economic headwinds continued to hurt investor confidence. Philippine Stock Exchange Index (PSEi) inched up by 0.2 percent, or 10.96 points, to close at 5,511.84.
